tiers.about: Shutter finishes by budget tier. PROPOSED by the generator and approved for use (2026-11-23; acrylic added 2026-11-25 when the MagickHome textures API showed Rehau acrylic finishes): the rule workbook says finish tiers are derived from the budget tier but defines no finish rows. Edit this file to MagickHome's real rules - the generator, the AI designer's choices and the UI follow it. 'base' = base + tall units, 'wall' = wall units + lofts. Finishes come from the textures API (category Laminate / PU / Acrylic).

essential.note: Laminate fronts on every run - durable and lowest cost.

premium.note: Laminate fronts with one PU or acrylic accent run (the base run or the wall run).

luxury.note: PU matte or acrylic high-gloss fronts on every run.

auto.why: MagickHome sample palette: Cadet Blue PU base, Stromma White PU wall run.

essential.why: Warm oak laminate below, calm Dove grey laminate above.

premium.why: Oak laminate base with a bright Stromma White PU accent on the wall run.

luxury.why: Two-tone PU: Cadet Blue base, Stromma White wall run.

match: Tall units take the base-run finish and lofts take the wall-run finish (finish continuity).
Fillers, slabs, end panels and cover panels take the finish of the run they close (workbook: Filler Panel / Cover End Panel finish must match the cabinets).
